Systems Engineer – Cisco & Microsoft Identity Security

Neteffects | Gold Coast

$90,000 - $100,000 – Full-time

This is a niche role for a rare kind of engineer: someone who can sell a Cisco solution, build it and then secure the Microsoft identity environment around it.

Neteffects is looking for an experienced Systems Engineer to join our growing team in a specialist, hybrid role. You'll work across Cisco pre-sales and solution design, hands-on Cisco and Meraki engineering, and Microsoft identity security.

Neteffects is based on the Gold Coast. For more than 26 years we've provided IT consulting, managed services and technology support to organisations in Australia and around the world.

This is a full-time position based in our Gold Coast office.

Why This Role Is Different

Most engineers are strong in one area: networking, Microsoft or sales. This role needs all three.

You'll be the person customers trust to understand their business needs and recommend the right Cisco solution. You'll then design and deploy it yourself and make sure their users, devices and access are properly secured through Microsoft Entra ID.

If you enjoy talking with customers as much as configuring switches and Conditional Access policies, this role was built for you.

The Role

Cisco Sales & Solution Design

  • Working with customers and our account team to understand business and technical requirements

  • Scoping, designing and proposing Cisco and Meraki solutions

  • Preparing bills of materials, solution designs and technical proposals

  • Running technical presentations, demonstrations and proof-of-concept work

  • Spotting opportunities to improve customers' network and security posture

  • Supporting Neteffects' Cisco partnership and helping meet its requirements

Cisco Technical Engineering

  • Deploying and configuring Cisco and Meraki switching, routing, wireless, SD-WAN and security appliances

  • Designing and implementing VLANs, VPNs, firewall policies and secure network segmentation

  • Handling escalated network issues and finding the root cause

  • Delivering network upgrades, refreshes and implementation projects

  • Managing ongoing customer networks

Microsoft Identity Security

  • Designing and implementing identity security in Microsoft Entra ID

  • Building and managing Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless authentication

  • Implementing Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and least-privilege access models

  • Managing identity governance, access reviews and lifecycle workflows

  • Supporting hybrid identity with Entra Connect and Active Directory

  • Hardening Microsoft 365 tenants and responding to identity-related security alerts

  • Integrating network access with Microsoft identity, including SSO, RADIUS/802.1X and secure remote access

Across Everything

  • Mentoring and supporting other members of the team

  • Maintaining accurate technical documentation and solution designs

  • Providing remote and onsite support across South East Queensland when required

Technologies You'll Work With

Cisco & Networking

  • Cisco Catalyst switching and routing

  • Cisco Meraki (MX, MS, MR, MV)

  • Cisco Secure Firewall

  • Cisco Duo

  • Cisco ISE

  • Cisco Umbrella / Secure Access

  • SD-WAN, VPN and wireless infrastructure

Microsoft Identity & Security

  • Microsoft Entra ID

  • Conditional Access and MFA

  • Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

  • Entra ID Governance

  • Entra Connect / hybrid identity

  • Microsoft Intune

  • Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online

  • Microsoft Defender for Identity

  • Windows Server and Active Directory

Also in Our Stack

  • Microsoft Azure and AWS

  • Veeam

  • Trend Micro

  • ConnectWise

  • Lenovo

Mandatory Certifications

You must hold all the following current certifications:

  • CCNA – Cisco Certified Network Associate

  • 700-150 – Introduction to Cisco Sales (ICS)

  • SC-300 – Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator

  • MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator

  • Minimum - Associate Degree in Information Technology

Applications without all five certifications will not be considered.

What We're Looking For

As well as the certifications above, you'll bring:

  • Proven experience in Cisco pre-sales, solution design or technical sales

  • Strong hands-on experience deploying and supporting Cisco and/or Meraki environments

  • Solid experience securing Microsoft Entra ID, especially Conditional Access, MFA and privileged access

  • Experience with hybrid identity and Active Directory

  • Confidence presenting to customers, from IT teams through to business decision-makers

  • Experience in an MSP, IT service provider or Cisco partner environment

Highly regarded:

  • Cisco ISE, Duo or Umbrella experience

  • Further Cisco certifications (CCNP, Meraki CMNA, Cisco security specialisations)

  • Further Microsoft security certifications (SC-200, SC-100, AZ-500)

  • PowerShell and automation skills

  • Understanding of frameworks such as the Essential Eight or Zero Trust

More Than Technical Skills

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is equally comfortable in a customer meeting and in a network cabinet

  • Can turn customer problems into practical, well-designed solutions

  • Takes ownership of problems and sees them through

  • Delivers exceptional customer service

  • Communicates well with both technical and non-technical people

  • Manages their own workload and priorities

  • Is happy to share their knowledge with the team

  • Takes pride in doing things properly

Why Neteffects?

We've always believed talented people do their best work when they're trusted to do their jobs.

Our workplace has been featured in the Gold Coast Bulletin, The Australian and American Workplace Magazine.

We've worked hard to create an enjoyable workplace where people are given flexibility and responsibility.

Your workday is yours to manage.

It has never made sense to us to hire the brightest minds and then tell them how to do their jobs. We want our engineers to own their work, manage their time responsibly and deliver excellent outcomes for our customers.

We also offer:

  • Well above-average pay

  • A generous bonus system

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Ongoing training and certification support

  • A specialist role with real influence over customer solutions

  • A clear path into senior, architecture and specialist roles

Build Your Career With Us

Engineers who can combine Cisco sales, network engineering and Microsoft identity security are rare, and we know it. This role gives you the chance to shape customer solutions from the first conversation through to secure, well-run environments.

If you're exceptional at what you do, provide spectacular customer service and want to work somewhere that gives you the freedom to do your best work, we want to hear from you.

All Orbits, All Planets - Join us on our journey

Gilmour Space is a leading Australian space company, developing launch vehicles, satellite platforms, advanced propulsion technologies; and launching from our licensed orbital spaceport in Bowen, North Queensland.

We are seeking a Software Services Engineer I to join the development team for Gilmour Space’s in-house Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. The software you create plays a central role in engineering and manufacturing bills of materials, component and requirement revisions, change orders, configuration management, sourcing and purchasing data for our launch vehicles and satellites. Engineering, manufacturing and supply chain teams rely on it every day, and the outcomes flow straight into what we build and fly.

We are seeking a Software Services Engineer I with a backend and systems focus to help design, build and run our PLM system. Your contributions will include designing and implement APIs, modelling engineering data flows, writing and executing migrations for production data, enforcing permissions, and connecting integrations with the other business critical systems, conduct reviews, and enhance CI/CD as required. You will also produce documentation and communicate across teams to ensure tasks are completed efficiently and on time, while adhering to Gilmour Space policies and procedures

How you will contribute to our mission in getting Australia to space:

The below is designed to give you an idea of the role you will play. There will be many more exciting and innovative things to do:

  • Model complex, revision-controlled engineering data, including assemblies and BOM trees, design baselines and precise/unprecise assembly trees, change orders, requirements and verification methods.
  •  Design DB schemas, indexes and queries with attention to document growth, query cost and transactional consistency, and choose simple, readable queries where they will do the job.
  • Build and maintain integrations and scheduled sync jobs with internal and third-party systems, including REST and GraphQL APIs, covering authentication and token refresh, pagination, timeouts, retries and clear error reporting.
  • Raise focused merge requests and take an active part in code review, both giving and acting on detailed technical feedback.
  • Maintain and improve the GitLab CI/CD pipeline, unit, integration and end-to-end tests, container images, Ansible deployment, backup and restore processes, and secrets management.
  • Write and maintain technical documentation, design notes and architecture diagrams.

Mandatory Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. Alternatively, demonstrated ability and experience equivalent to degree level.
  • Proficiency in at least one statically typed backend language (Go preferred), and willingness to work primarily in Go.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building and maintaining backend services and APIs that other people or systems depend on. Note that experience consuming APIs from a front end only is not sufficient.
  • Ability to operate in dynamic, fast-paced environments, and resilience in high-pressure situations.
  • Modern JS framework and TypeScript
  • Component architecture and state management
  • Auth sessions, tokens, protected routes
  • API integration, caching, local storage

Desired Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

We recognise you may not meet all of the below, but don’t let that deter you. We are always looking for hard workers to join our team, so what are you waiting for? Let’s send Australia to space!

  • Production experience with Go.
  • Experience modelling data and working with a database in a production setting (document or relational), including indexes, transactions and schema changes.
  • Contract-first API development with OpenAPI and code generation.
  • Integrating with SaaS and ERP APIs, including GraphQL clients, OAuth 2.0, token refresh and rate limits.
  • A solid understanding of HTTP and REST API design: resource modelling, status codes, error handling, pagination and backwards compatibility.
  • Authentication and authorisation: OIDC and OAuth 2.0, identity providers and role-based access control.
  • Docker, reverse proxies, Linux administration and Ansible.
  • GitLab CI/CD and secrets management
  • Observability: structured logging, OpenTelemetry tracing and dashboards.
  • Event-driven patterns: domain events, webhooks, background jobs and workflow schedulers.
  • An understanding of concurrency and consistency problems, such as race conditions, lost updates and optimistic locking.
  • Knowledge of PLM, configuration management or ERP: bills of materials, revision and change control, and requirements traceability.
  • Experience working with at least one UI Component Library and TypeScript.
  • Working knowledge of Git, merge request workflows and code review.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools with sound engineering judgement.
  • Understanding of systems engineering practices.
  • The ability to explain and reason about design trade-offs clearly.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Kanban ways of working.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a team, with a desire to help other team members in the day-to-day running of the department.

How to Apply:

Applicants must be an Australian Citizen/Permanent Resident or have an appropriate Australian work visa or work entitlements.

If you are a proactive team player with a passion to get Australia to space and a desire to succeed, please apply now by clicking the apply button and including your resume and cover letter or head to our website: CAREER | Gilmour Space Technologies | Rocket launch provider (gspace.com). 

Gilmour Space Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples for all positions.

Change Manager

We're Feros Care, and we're pleased to meet you.

And what we care most about is helping people live healthier, happier, better-connected lives.

Since 1990, we've been making it happen, both for older Australians and people with disability.

We are proud to be Game Changers. Dream Makers. Kindness Champions. Culture Shapers. Vibrant Creators. And it's not just us who thinks so; We've won many awards on the local and international stage for our approach.

We're looking for an experienced Change Manager to help guide our people through important change initiatives on a 2 year fixed term contract, based in our Coolangatta office with flexible hybrid working arrangements.

Build capability, embrace continuous improvement and bring people along the journey of change.

In this role you'll combine change management expertise with a practical, people focused approach. From understanding how change will impact different teams, to developing communications, delivering training and supporting people through new ways of working, you'll play a key role in helping employees feel informed, supported and confident throughout the change process.

Whether it's introducing new technology, improving systems and processes or supporting broader transformation initiatives, you'll work closely with leaders, project teams and frontline employees to help make change happen in a way that works for our people, ensuring they understand what's changing, why it matters and how they can confidently adapt.

What you'll do

  • Develop and deliver change strategies and plans that support successful transformation.
  • Assess change impacts, readiness and support requirements across the business.
  • Partner with leaders, project teams and employees to drive engagement and adoption.
  • Deliver communications that keep people informed, engaged and involved.
  • Facilitate workshops and conversations that build understanding and commitment to change.
  • Develop training, resources and tools that support new ways of working.
  • Support leaders and frontline teams through change and implementation.
  • Coordinate change activities with project teams to drive readiness and adoption.
  • Gather feedback and insights to identify risks, opportunities and support needs.
  • Address resistance and support successful adoption of change initiatives.
  • Measure change outcomes and drive continuous improvement.
  • Help build a culture of adaptability, learning and continuous improvement.
  • Support change initiatives across complex transformation programs.

What you'll bring

  • 3 - 5 years' experience delivering change initiatives and supporting adoption.
  • Experience supporting large scale transformation, technology or system change programs.
  • Knowledge of change methodologies and frameworks such as PROSCI, ADKAR or Kotter, and the ability to apply them in practice.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills across all levels.
  • Experience developing communications, engagement activities and learning resources.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation and workshop delivery skills.
  • Well developed planning, organisation and project coordination skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and change impact assessment capability.
  • A proactive, adaptable and solutions focused approach.
  • Ability to work autonomously and demonstrate initiative.
  • Experience working in complex and evolving environments.
  • Professional services or consulting experience will be highly regarded.

Qualifications & Checks

  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Human Resources, Organisational Psychology, Change Management or a related discipline, and/or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Change Management certification (Prosci, ACMP or similar) will be highly regarded.
  • Current unrestricted Australian Driver's Licence (desirable).
  • Undergo a Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check.
  • Valid Australian working rights.

Why Feros Care?
At Feros Care, we value our people and offer:

  • Not for Profit Salary Packaging of up to $15,900 per annum, and meal and entertainment salary sacrifice of up to $2,650 per annum, all tax free, stretching your income further.
  • Flexible Working Arrangements, including a hybrid model with a combination of working from our Coolangatta office and the flexibility to work remotely.
  • 17.5% Annual Leave loading.

  • Enjoy exclusive discounts, financial tips, and wellness programs through our ForME employee benefits platform.
  • Private Health Insurance Discount with Medibank.

Join Centorrino Technologies: Innovate, Grow, and Thrive with Us!

At Centorrino Technologies (CT), we’re more than just tech—we’re a community that goes beyond expectations. We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work in 2025 and Top 5 Inspiring Workplaces for 2026, with an outstanding eNPS score of 68. And we’re not stopping there. We're on a mission to redefine the customer experience, and we need a passionate Cyber Security Analyst to join our Cyber team in Australia.

The Security Analyst delivers frontline managed cyber security services across client environments. The role monitors and validates security alerts, investigates suspected threats, coordinates proportionate response actions and manages the endpoint and user protection controls as assigned to the Cyber Security Operations Centre (CSOC). 

The role operates on a permanent night shift, working shifts from 10:30pm to 7:00am AEST. We have three roster patterns available: Tuesday to Saturday, Sunday to Thursday, and Friday to Tuesday. These positions require flexibility to work overnight hours and across weekends as part of our 24/7 Cyber Security Operations Centre.

Requirements

What you'll do:

  • Monitor security alerts across client environments, validating and prioritising potential threats using available context, threat intelligence and asset criticality.
  • Investigate security events and coordinate appropriate responses to low- and medium-severity incidents within agreed service levels.
  • Perform initial containment actions, including endpoint isolation, account deactivation and blocking malicious IP addresses or URLs.
  • Maintain accurate incident records, investigation notes, evidence, timelines and response actions.
  • Escalate high-severity, complex or widespread incidents, providing clear findings, impact assessments and recommended next steps.
  • Identify recurring alert patterns, control gaps and opportunities to improve security detection and response.
  • Deliver timely, clear and actionable updates to clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring services meet contractual obligations and service level requirements.
  • Contribute to effective shift handovers, knowledge articles, operational reporting and continuous improvement of SOC processes and playbooks.
  • Support the delivery of Managed Cyber Security Services (MCSS), including application control, email and DNS security, password management, deep-web monitoring and security awareness programs.
  • Review service requests, investigate blocked applications or communications, administer security policies and exceptions, troubleshoot security controls and maintain accurate customer and ticket records.

What you'll bring:

  • Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity detection and response, including frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain.
  • Familiarity with security technologies such as EDR/XDR, SIEM, SOAR, application control and email security platforms.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel and Fortinet security platforms will be highly regarded.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate security events, assess findings and determine when escalation is required.
  • A curious mindset and genuine interest in developing your technical knowledge, investigating unfamiliar activity and continuously improving security operations capability.
  • The ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and follow established procedures within a 24/7 operational environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A disciplined approach to documentation, ticket management and incident handovers, with a focus on accuracy and operational continuity.
  • SOC-focused certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, BTL1, GCIH or equivalent will be advantageous.
  • Australian citizenship and the ability to obtain an NV1 security clearance. Holding a current NV1 clearance will be highly regarded.

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here:

Our company is more than just a workplace, it's a hub of inspiration and creativity where employees love to work! Here's why:

  • Hybrid working (for majority of our roles) with team anchor days to support collaboration.
  • Extensive training and development opportunities that enable continual growth as part of your career planning.
  • Extensive discounts and benefits to maximise your money.
  • A choice of your IT equipment to maximise your success and access to cost-price tech for your personal needs.
  • Fun team events to celebrate achievements and connect with colleagues outside work as part of our engaging culture.

 

CT celebrates diversity and enables every voice to be heard as we drive to create the world we want. Apply today and be part of a team that values innovation, inclusivity, variety and diverse backgrounds.

 

Note: A valid Vulnerable People / Working with Children Check (WWCC) and Police Check are required.

ABOUT US 

At Alpha Car Hire, we’re passionate about making road experiences easy and affordable through quality vehicles and exceptional customer service. As one of Australia’s leading independent car hire companies, we rely on connected systems to support our branch network. When those systems work well, our teams spend less time checking records or repeating tasks and more time looking after customers. 


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY 

We’re seeking a senior Systems Integration Engineer (AI & Automation) to take ownership of the systems, integrations and automations our branch and head office teams use every day. You’ll lead a small team of developers who report directly to you, while spending most of your time on hands-on development. This is a permanent, full-time hybrid role based at our modern office in Robina on the Gold Coast.

Your first priority will be to understand what’s already running, keep it reliable and improve it where it matters most. That might mean tracing a missing update across two systems, restoring the data and fixing the cause, or working alongside a branch team to automate a manual check and measure how much time it saves.

As a member of the senior leadership team (SLT), you’ll work directly with the CEO and functional leaders to decide where technology investment will have the greatest impact. You’ll have the autonomy to recommend what to improve, what to build and what can wait, balancing new initiatives with the security and reliability of live services. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Monitor existing automations, investigate failures and prevent recurring issues. Work with teams to trial AI where it could reduce rework or improve decisions, measure the results and agree where human review is needed.

  • Maintain and enhance Alpha’s internal software, APIs and integrations. Trace faults across applications and external platforms, verify fixes in production and document changes so others can support them.

  • Own the reliability and security of cloud infrastructure and data services. Manage access and credentials, test backups and recovery procedures, and lead the response when a critical service is disrupted.

  • Keep operational and financial data accurate and timely. Use logs, SQL and reconciliation checks to find missing or duplicated records and correct the problem at its source.

  • Lead technical delivery by writing, reviewing and releasing software alongside your team. Use approved AI tools, set engineering standards and manage the team’s day-to-day priorities. Coach developers through code reviews and regular feedback, and bring in specialist providers where needed.

  • Shape the technology and AI roadmap with the CEO and SLT. Challenge assumptions, explain costs and risks, and report on delivery progress and whether each investment achieved its intended benefit.

  • Partner with branch and head office teams to understand how work gets done. Involve users in testing, support them through rollout and use their feedback to prioritise the next improvement.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 

  • Substantial hands-on software development experience, with examples of applications you’ve maintained and improved after they went live.

  • Strong JavaScript or TypeScript and Node.js skills, including experience connecting internal and third-party systems through REST APIs, webhooks and scheduled jobs. Experience with Next.js or React is also valuable.

  • Strong SQL skills in SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including investigating failed data transfers, reconciling records and checking that reports reflect the underlying data.

  • Practical experience supporting Azure-hosted applications and using Git, Docker and Azure DevOps pipelines to test, deploy and verify releases.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools in your own coding, with the judgement to review and test their output. Experience integrating AI services into business workflows is highly regarded.

  • Sound judgement around access, security, backups and recovery, and experience diagnosing incidents across connected services.

  • The ability to lead and develop a small team, coordinate external providers, explain technical choices to business leaders and show how your work improved a business outcome.

  • Graphic design skills, including the ability to create clear, engaging visuals for internal tools and communications, are desirable.


WHY ALPHA 

You’ll work directly with the people who use the software and the leaders who decide what gets funded. You can raise a recurring problem with the CEO, recommend a practical fix and stay involved long enough to see whether it worked. 

  • Hybrid work with time at home and in our modern Robina office. 

  • Company-paid accounts for approved AI tools and the opportunity to apply them to real business problems. 

  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 

  • Car hire discounts for you, your friends and your family. 

If you enjoy working out why systems fail, writing software that makes someone’s day easier and having a say in what gets built next, we’d love to hear from you! Apply through SEEK with your Cover Letter & CV.

Role Summary
Veracross Customer Support Specialists provide the first level of customer support, working on our Technical Support Team to provide well-informed and timely responses to customer questions and issues. They act as a crucial link between internal engineering teams and product users. This individual applies their basic knowledge of a product area to the unique needs of the customer in order to guide users to resolutions. This position requires analytical and general software problem-solving skills and a commitment to service and quality. The Customer Support Specialist reports directly to the Director of Support.

Job Responsibilities

  • Interact directly with customers via several channels, including a ticketing system and building relationships by consistently demonstrating expertise and professionalism
  • Manage and prioritise multiple open cases at one time
  • Ask customers targeted questions to quickly understand and diagnose the root of a problem
  • Analyse customer requests, replicating, researching, and resolving technical problems and questions and guiding the client to our knowledge base solutions whenever possible
  • Provide prompt and accurate responses to clients, tracking cases through resolution within company SLA guidelines
  • Collaborate with the support consultant and support engineering teams to escalate issues that cannot be resolved by a specialist
  • Identify, update, and maintain internal and external knowledge bases in order to improve support documentation deficiencies
  • Gain a detailed understanding of at least one support specialist team with knowledge of those software modules and how they are used by schools

Requirements

  • Customer Service Experience
  • 0-2 years of experience working in client support in the software industry
  • Demonstrated aptitude for using, teaching, and communicating information about technologically sophisticated software to non-technical users
  • Demonstrated excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Passionate about learning new software, able to build, retain, and apply knowledge across a variety of product areas
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills, able to analyse customer requests and provide them with timely resolutions
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as a member of a team in an open space environment.
  • Friendly with a positive attitude and a desire to contribute to a positive community culture
  • Industry knowledge of the K-12 private school sector and other education SaaS products a plus
  • This role is based in Australia, and citizenship or permanent residence is required

Growth opportunities!

Veracross is growing fast, allowing you to own your role and grow with us! Operating within a global team, there are opportunities for professional development allowing your skills to grow as the business grows.

Work/life balance

Parental leave policy

Make a difference

Our work makes a positive contribution to our schools, their students and their families around the world!

Snacks, drinks & coffee

Digistorm’s (Veracross) Gold Coast HQ offers a coffee machine, snack bar and fully stocked drinks fridge to keep energy levels high! Vege chips, kombucha, almond milk, cookies; you name it, they have it.

Culture

The Veracross team is fun, relaxed, and sociable, reflected in the casual dress code and social events. The office has an open floor plan, which allows for cross-team communication and a collaborative environment.
